properties.description:
Copy huge amount of data in bulk from database using external control table to store source table list with partitions for each table.

When you want to migrate data from your Azure Synapse Analytics like Oracle server, Netezza server, Teradata server or SQL Server to Azure, you have to load huge amount of data from multiple tables in data sources. In most cases, data has to be further partitioned in each table so that you can load rows with multiple threads in parallel from single table.

text.value:
USE aer_synapse_db;

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. RUN STAMP + SOURCE WINDOW
-- @StartDate/@EndDate come from the pipeline (same watermark
-- window as PL_EIA_IncrementalIngestion), NOT today's date --
-- Bronze is partitioned by start_date=/end_date=, not by a
-- flat run date.
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @StartDate NVARCHAR(10) = '@{pipeline().parameters.StartDate}';
DECLARE @EndDate   NVARCHAR(10) = '@{pipeline().parameters.EndDate}';

DECLARE @RunStamp NVARCHAR(25) =
    REPLACE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 120), '-', '')
    + '_'
    + REPLACE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 108), ':', '');

DECLARE @TableName NVARCHAR(200) = 'dbo.fact_oilprice_' + @RunStamp;
DECLARE @Location  NVARCHAR(400) =
    '/gold/fact_oilprice/' + @StartDate + '_' + @EndDate + '/run_' + @RunStamp + '/';
DECLARE @BronzePath NVARCHAR(400) =
    '/bronze/oilprice/start_date=' + @StartDate + '/end_date=' + @EndDate + '/*.parquet';

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. DROP EXISTING EXTERNAL TABLE METADATA IF RE-RUNNING
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @DropSQL NVARCHAR(MAX) =
    N'IF OBJECT_ID(''' + @TableName + N''') IS NOT NULL DROP EXTERNAL TABLE ' + @TableName + N';';
EXEC sp_executesql @DropSQL;

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. CETAS: Bronze EIA Parquet -> Gold OilPrice Parquet
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX) =
    N'CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE ' + @TableName + N'
WITH
(
    LOCATION = ''' + @Location + N''',
    DATA_SOURCE = aer_adls,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
)
AS
SELECT
    TRY_CAST([period] AS DATE) AS PriceDate,
    TRY_CAST([value] AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OilPrice_USD,
    [series-description] AS SeriesDescription,
    GETDATE() AS Loaded_At
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK ''' + @BronzePath + N''',
    DATA_SOURCE = ''aer_adls'',
    FORMAT = ''PARQUET''
) AS b
WHERE [period] IS NOT NULL
  AND [value] IS NOT NULL
  AND TRY_CAST([value] AS DECIMAL(10,2)) IS NOT NULL;';

EXEC sp_executesql @SQL;

scripts.text:
USE aer_synapse_db;

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. RUN DATE VARIABLES
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @RunDate NVARCHAR(10) =
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 120);

DECLARE @RunDateClean NVARCHAR(8) =
    REPLACE(@RunDate, '-', '');


------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. DROP EXISTING DAILY EXTERNAL TABLES
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @DropSQL NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'
    IF OBJECT_ID(''dbo.quarantine_' + @RunDateClean + N''') IS NOT NULL
        DROP EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.quarantine_' + @RunDateClean + N';

    IF OBJECT_ID(''dbo.silver_clean_' + @RunDateClean + N''') IS NOT NULL
        DROP EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.silver_clean_' + @RunDateClean + N';
';

EXEC sp_executesql @DropSQL;


------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. CREATE QUARANTINE EXTERNAL TABLE
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @QuarantineSQL NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.quarantine_' + @RunDateClean + N'
WITH
(
    LOCATION = ''/quarantine/well_rejects/' + @RunDate + N'/'',
    DATA_SOURCE = aer_adls,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
)
AS
SELECT
    UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT AS WellID,
    WELL_NAME AS WellName,
    LICENSE_NO AS LicenceNumber,
    LICENCE_STATUS AS LicenceStatus,
    LICENSE_ISSUE_DATE AS LicenceIssueDate,
    OPERATOR_CODE AS OperatorCode,
    WELL_TOTAL_DEPTH AS WellTotalDepth,

    CASE
        WHEN UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT IS NULL
             OR UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT = ''''
            THEN ''NULL_UWI''

        WHEN LEN(LICENSE_ISSUE_DATE) <> 8
            THEN ''INVALID_DATE''

        WHEN TRY_CAST(WELL_TOTAL_DEPTH AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) < 0
            THEN ''NEGATIVE_DEPTH''

        ELSE ''OTHER''
    END AS RejectReason,

    GETDATE() AS QuarantineDate

FROM OPENROWSET
(
    BULK ''/bronze/well/' + @RunDate + N'/*.parquet'',
    DATA_SOURCE = ''aer_adls'',
    FORMAT = ''PARQUET''
) AS b

WHERE UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT IS NULL
   OR UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT = ''''
   OR LEN(LICENSE_ISSUE_DATE) <> 8
   OR TRY_CAST(WELL_TOTAL_DEPTH AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) < 0;
';

EXEC sp_executesql @QuarantineSQL;


------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. CREATE CLEAN SILVER EXTERNAL TABLE
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @SilverSQL NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.silver_clean_' + @RunDateClean + N'
WITH
(
    LOCATION = ''/silver/clean/' + @RunDate + N'/'',
    DATA_SOURCE = aer_adls,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
)
AS
SELECT
    UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT AS WellID,
    KEY_LIST_OF_WELLS AS WellKeyID,

    LTRIM(RTRIM(WELL_NAME)) AS WellName,

    FIELD_CODE AS FieldCode,
    POOL_CODE AS PoolCode,

    LICENSE_NO AS LicenceNumber,
    LICENCE_STATUS AS LicenceStatus,

    TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LICENSE_ISSUE_DATE, 112) AS LicenceIssueDate,

    LICENSEE_CODE AS LicenseeCode,
    OPERATOR_CODE AS OperatorCode,

    TRY_CONVERT(DATE, FIN_DRL_DATE, 112) AS FinDrlDate,

    TRY_CAST(
        WELL_TOTAL_DEPTH AS DECIMAL(10, 2)
    ) AS WellTotalDepth,

    WELL_STAT_CODE AS WellStatCode,

    TRY_CONVERT(
        DATE,
        WELL_STAT_DATE,
        112
    ) AS WellStatDate,

    CASE
        WHEN FLUID_SHORT_DESC = ''N/A''
            THEN NULL
        ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(FLUID_SHORT_DESC))
    END AS FluidDesc,

    CASE
        WHEN MODE_SHORT_DESC = ''N/A''
            THEN NULL
        ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(MODE_SHORT_DESC))
    END AS ModeDesc,

    CASE
        WHEN TYPE_SHORT_DESC = ''N/A''
            THEN NULL
        ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(TYPE_SHORT_DESC))
    END AS TypeDesc,

    CASE
        WHEN STRUCTURE_SHORT_DESC = ''N/A''
            THEN NULL
        ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(STRUCTURE_SHORT_DESC))
    END AS StructureDesc,

    ''BATCH_' + @RunDate + N''' AS BatchID,

    GETDATE() AS IngestionDate,

    ''WellList.txt'' AS SourceFile

FROM OPENROWSET
(
    BULK ''/bronze/well/' + @RunDate + N'/*.parquet'',
    DATA_SOURCE = ''aer_adls'',
    FORMAT = ''PARQUET''
) AS b

WHERE UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT IS NOT NULL
  AND UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT <> ''''
  AND LEN(LICENSE_ISSUE_DATE) = 8
  AND TRY_CAST(WELL_TOTAL_DEPTH AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) >= 0;
';

EXEC sp_executesql @SilverSQL;

RowsWritten = actual gold.Dim_Well SCD2 rows updated/inserted (not total Gold snapshot rows). SCD2 Script failures are logged by the child to ADF_Pipeline_Log after PipelineRunDetail logging and before explicit child Fail. FINAL V2: preserves SCD2 SQL/metrics and routes operational failure persistence through common handler. Coordinated Instrumentation V3: existing StartTime/EndTime/RowsRead/RowsWritten instrumentation retained. V4: explicit StartTime, EndTime and DurationSeconds expressions passed to usp_LogPipelineRunDetail. scripts.text:
DECLARE @BatchDate DATE = CAST(SYSUTCDATETIME() AS DATE);
DECLARE @RowsRead BIGINT = (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM staging.Silver_Wells);
DECLARE @DimWellRowsWritten BIGINT = 0;

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. DIM_OPERATOR - SCD TYPE 2 FROM CURRENT DELTA
------------------------------------------------------------
UPDATE t
SET t.[Is_Current] = 0,
    t.Effective_To = @BatchDate,
    t.Updated_At = SYSUTCDATETIME()
FROM gold.Dim_Operator AS t
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT OperatorCode, LicenseeCode
    FROM staging.Silver_Wells
    WHERE OperatorCode IS NOT NULL AND OperatorCode <> ''
) AS s
  ON t.OperatorCode = s.OperatorCode
 AND t.[Is_Current] = 1
WHERE ISNULL(t.LicenseeCode,'') <> ISNULL(s.LicenseeCode,'');

INSERT INTO gold.Dim_Operator
(OperatorCode, LicenseeCode, Effective_From, Effective_To, [Is_Current])
SELECT DISTINCT s.OperatorCode, s.LicenseeCode, @BatchDate, '9999-12-31', 1
FROM staging.Silver_Wells AS s
WHERE s.OperatorCode IS NOT NULL
  AND s.OperatorCode <> ''
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM gold.Dim_Operator AS d
      WHERE d.OperatorCode = s.OperatorCode
        AND ISNULL(d.LicenseeCode,'') = ISNULL(s.LicenseeCode,'')
        AND d.[Is_Current] = 1
  );

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. DIM_WELL - SCD TYPE 2 FROM CURRENT DELTA
------------------------------------------------------------
UPDATE t
SET t.[Is_Current] = 0,
    t.Effective_To = @BatchDate,
    t.Updated_At = SYSUTCDATETIME()
FROM gold.Dim_Well AS t
INNER JOIN staging.Silver_Wells AS s
  ON t.WellID = s.WellID
 AND t.[Is_Current] = 1
WHERE ISNULL(t.WellName,'') <> ISNULL(s.WellName,'')
   OR ISNULL(t.FieldCode,'') <> ISNULL(s.FieldCode,'')
   OR ISNULL(t.LicenseeCode,'') <> ISNULL(s.LicenseeCode,'')
   OR ISNULL(t.OperatorCode,'') <> ISNULL(s.OperatorCode,'')
   OR ISNULL(t.LicenceStatus,'') <> ISNULL(s.LicenceStatus,'')
   OR ISNULL(t.WellTotalDepth,-1) <> ISNULL(s.WellTotalDepth,-1)
   OR ISNULL(t.WellStatCode,'') <> ISNULL(s.WellStatCode,'')
   OR ISNULL(t.FluidDesc,'') <> ISNULL(s.FluidDesc,'')
   OR ISNULL(t.ModeDesc,'') <> ISNULL(s.ModeDesc,'');
SET @DimWellRowsWritten += @@ROWCOUNT;

INSERT INTO gold.Dim_Well
(WellID, WellName, FieldCode, LicenseeCode, OperatorCode, LicenceStatus,
 WellTotalDepth, WellStatCode, FluidDesc, ModeDesc,
 Effective_From, Effective_To, [Is_Current])
SELECT s.WellID, s.WellName, s.FieldCode, s.LicenseeCode, s.OperatorCode,
       s.LicenceStatus, s.WellTotalDepth, s.WellStatCode, s.FluidDesc, s.ModeDesc,
       @BatchDate, '9999-12-31', 1
FROM staging.Silver_Wells AS s
WHERE s.WellID IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM gold.Dim_Well AS d
      WHERE d.WellID = s.WellID AND d.[Is_Current] = 1
  );
SET @DimWellRowsWritten += @@ROWCOUNT;

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. DIM_LICENCESTATUS - NEW DELTA VALUES ONLY
------------------------------------------------------------
MERGE gold.Dim_LicenceStatus AS t
USING (
    SELECT DISTINCT LicenceStatus
    FROM staging.Silver_Wells
    WHERE LicenceStatus IS NOT NULL
) AS s
ON t.LicenceStatus = s.LicenceStatus
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (LicenceStatus) VALUES (s.LicenceStatus);

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. DIM_WELLTYPE - NEW DELTA COMBINATIONS ONLY
------------------------------------------------------------
MERGE gold.Dim_WellType AS t
USING (
    SELECT DISTINCT FluidDesc, ModeDesc, TypeDesc, StructureDesc
    FROM staging.Silver_Wells
) AS s
ON  ISNULL(t.FluidDesc,'') = ISNULL(s.FluidDesc,'')
AND ISNULL(t.ModeDesc,'') = ISNULL(s.ModeDesc,'')
AND ISNULL(t.TypeDesc,'') = ISNULL(s.TypeDesc,'')
AND ISNULL(t.StructureDesc,'') = ISNULL(s.StructureDesc,'')
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT (FluidDesc, ModeDesc, TypeDesc, StructureDesc)
VALUES (s.FluidDesc, s.ModeDesc, s.TypeDesc, s.StructureDesc);

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. FACT_OILPRICE - EXISTING UPSERT
------------------------------------------------------------
MERGE gold.Fact_OilPrice AS t
USING (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(period AS DATE) AS PriceDate,
           TRY_CAST(value AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OilPrice_USD,
           [series-description] AS SeriesDescription
    FROM staging.OilPrice
    WHERE period IS NOT NULL AND value IS NOT NULL
) AS s
ON t.PriceDate = s.PriceDate
WHEN MATCHED AND ISNULL(t.OilPrice_USD,-1) <> ISNULL(s.OilPrice_USD,-1)
THEN UPDATE SET t.OilPrice_USD = s.OilPrice_USD, t.Updated_At = SYSUTCDATETIME()
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT (PriceDate, OilPrice_USD, SeriesDescription, Created_At, Updated_At)
VALUES (s.PriceDate, s.OilPrice_USD, s.SeriesDescription, SYSUTCDATETIME(), SYSUTCDATETIME());

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. FACT_WELLSNAPSHOT - FULL DAILY SNAPSHOT FROM GOLD CURRENT STATE
------------------------------------------------------------
DELETE FROM gold.Fact_WellSnapshot WHERE SnapshotDate = @BatchDate;

INSERT INTO gold.Fact_WellSnapshot
(SnapshotDate, WellID, OperatorCode, LicenceStatus, FluidDesc, ModeDesc, FieldCode, WellTotalDepth)
SELECT @BatchDate, WellID, OperatorCode, LicenceStatus, FluidDesc, ModeDesc, FieldCode, WellTotalDepth
FROM gold.Dim_Well
WHERE [Is_Current] = 1;

SELECT @RowsRead AS RowsRead, @DimWellRowsWritten AS RowsWritten;

properties.description: ST37 WellList ingestion with NORMAL, REPLAY and BACKFILL modes. NORMAL uses control.PipelineWatermark plus control.PipelineConfig lookback and commits the watermark/window after successful copy and control logging. REPLAY/BACKFILL require explicit WindowStart/WindowEnd, reuse deterministic Bronze paths, and never advance the operational watermark. Copy activity is logged to control.PipelineRunDetail. WindowKey propagation hardened: empty keys fail fast and successful NORMAL runs persist LastSuccessfulWindowKey. Child owns exact ST37 copy failure logging in both PipelineRunDetail and ADF_Pipeline_Log before explicit Fail. Industry-refactor v1: returns SourceRowCount from the physical Copy output so downstream reconciliation consumes stage-produced metadata instead of rescanning ADLS. FINAL V2: common operational error handler used for copy failures. Instrumentation V3: copy StartTime/EndTime persisted; DurationSeconds derived by usp_LogPipelineRunDetail. V4: explicit StartTime, EndTime and DurationSeconds expressions passed to usp_LogPipelineRunDetail. Canonicalized ExecutePipeline parameters for PL_Common_Error_Handler; null-safe ParentRunId; resilient failure-handler dependency where applicable.

properties.description: Loads only the actual Silver delta into staging.Silver_Wells. HasRows now means SilverHasRows supplied by Bronze-to-Silver, not Bronze source HasRows. ParentRunId fallback is null-safe. V6: failure path hardened; common error handler runs even when PipelineRunDetail failure logging fails; ParentRunId null-safe throughout. V8: canonical ExecutePipeline parameter encoding; static values are raw strings, dynamic values are expression objects. Canonicalized ExecutePipeline parameters for PL_Common_Error_Handler; null-safe ParentRunId; resilient failure-handler dependency where applicable.
